title: He Could Have Run. Instead, He Picked Up His Violin.
description:
He is thirty-three years old. He plays the violin for a living. Tonight he is on the Titanic.
No one would have blamed him for trying for a boat. He chose to play instead.

On the night of April 14th, 1912, as the RMS Titanic sank beneath the North Atlantic, bandmaster Wallace Hartley led his eight musicians onto the open deck and kept playing until the ship was gone. None of them survived. This is a cinematic recreation of his final hours — and the violin that came back when he didn't.

New episodes every week. If this is the kind of history that stays with you, subscribe — it's the only thing we make.
